query: What concrete sampling-frame strategy ensures representative inclusion of Swedish SSH researchers by discipline, institution type, geography and career stage?

response.query: What concrete sampling-frame strategy ensures representative inclusion of Swedish SSH researchers by discipline, institution type, geography and career stage?
response.answer: Stratified random sampling ensures representative inclusion of Swedish SSH researchers by discipline, institution type, geography, and career stage. This method divides the population into distinct strata and randomly selects samples from each.

results.content: Mr. Chanchal Kumar is an Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officer of the 1992 batch from the Bihar cadre and currently serves as the Secretary, Ministry of Development of the North Eastern Region, Government of India. Godrej is the Chairperson of Godrej MIndustries Group; Chairperson and Managing Director of Godrej Industries Limited and Chairman of Godrej Agrovet Ltd. He is also the Co-Chair of Godrej Good & Green Governing Council. Mr. Mishra is currently working as Secretary in Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Government of India. He is Chairman & Managing Director of JK Tyre & Industries – Pioneers of Radial technology in India and manufacturers of the well known “JK Tyre”, “Vikrant” and “Tornel” brand of Tyres. Following the footstep of his illustrious father, Dr. Rama Prasad Goenka, Sanjiv was for two terms Chairman, Board of Governors of the Indian Institute of Technology, Kharagpur.A past President of All India Management Association (AIMA), Mr. Sanjiv Goenka now chairs the International Management Institute, India's first corporate-sponsored business school with campuses in Delhi, Kolkata and Bhubaneswar.
